title: The Kalopaideia Latin Examination
instructions: Three hours, no notes for Part A; printed lexicon and grammar permitted for Part B. Honor code: you affirm by submitting that you used only permitted aids. A failed examination may be retaken after thirty days.

items.prompt_latin: Quōusque tandem abūtēre, Catilīna, patientiā nostrā?
reference: how long, catiline, will you abuse our patience
how long finally will you abuse our patience catiline
how long catiline will you continue to abuse our patience

items.prompt_latin: Nihilne tē nocturnum praesidium Palātī, nihil urbis vigiliae, nihil timor populī, nihil concursus bonōrum omnium, nihil hic mūnītissimus habendī senātūs locus, nihil hōrum ōra vultūsque mōvērunt?
reference: has the night guard of the palatine moved you not at all, the city watches not at all, the fear of the people not at all, the gathering of all good men not at all, this most fortified place for holding the senate not at all, the faces and expressions of these men not at all
have these things moved you not at all: the night guard, the watches, the fear, the gathering, this fortified place, their faces

items.prompt_latin: Gallia est omnis dīvīsa in partēs trēs, quārum ūnam incolunt Belgae, aliam Aquītānī, tertiam quī ipsōrum linguā Celtae, nostrā Gallī appellantur.
reference: all gaul is divided into three parts, one of which the belgians inhabit, another the aquitani, a third those who in their own language are called celts, in ours gauls
gaul is wholly divided into three parts, of which the belgians inhabit one, the aquitani another, and those who are called celts in their language and gauls in ours inhabit a third

items.prompt_latin: Arma virumque canō, Troiae quī prīmus ab ōrīs Ītaliam fātō profugus Lāvīniaque vēnit lītora.
reference: i sing of arms and the man who first from the shores of troy came exiled by fate to italy and the lavinian shores
arms and the man i sing who first from troy's coasts came a fugitive by fate to italy and lavinium's shores
